note: The automation's own comments each end with an AI-disclosure footer, which drifts in wording (created/generated, maintainers/owner). Only the trailing footer line is kept verbatim — that drift is what the guard must survive; the narrative above it is condensed and the account replaced with a placeholder, so the repository does not publish the incident's timeline, account or operational detail. Every comment is posted under a normal user account, so sender.login cannot separate it from a reporter's.
